context: Evaluates use of the vue-draggable-plus VueDraggable component for sortable lists, and the matching store reorderItems action. The action must maintain kind-based separation of notebooks and notes, persist new positions using a gap-based index × 1000 formula, and update reactive state immediately before awaiting backend calls.
capability_tested: Drag-and-Drop Item Reordering with Position Persistence

checklist.name: VueDraggable component
checklist.description: The template uses VueDraggable (from vue-draggable-plus) with a v-model binding to the items list and a handler that calls reorderItems with the level, kind, and new sorted array.

checklist.name: Kind separation logic
checklist.description: reorderItems filters items of the other kind from the target level, then rebuilds items as [...notebooks, ...notes] to always maintain notebook-before-note ordering.

checklist.name: Gap-based position formula
checklist.description: Each item's new position is set to idx * 1000 (where idx is the 0-based index in the reordered array), both when calling the backend and when updating item.data.position.

checklist.name: Backend persistence calls
checklist.description: UpdateNotebookPosition or UpdateNotePosition is called for every item in newItems using Promise.all, passing the item id and a position object.

checklist.name: Reactive state first
checklist.description: The reactive items array on the target level is updated synchronously before the await Promise.all call, ensuring the UI reflects the new order immediately.
